blocks.text: The later bill is $44.39 every month.
The first parcel is thirty nine dollars and thirty four cents. The single parcel choice is the other line, and it is not the one marked.
The host is the shop you opened. No packing line is added. Rubber foot is not ticked. Firestarter puck, 8 count is a single item unless the repeat stays marked.
Ordinary ground carrier cost is already inside the tag.

product.description: The pucks light kindling and come eight to a tin.
product.name: Firestarter puck, 8 count

trick.evidence_text: The lower figure is only the first parcel. Later bills are $44.39 every month.
trick.instruction: Pick the single parcel line and turn the repeat off before you pay.
